ticket.identity: You are the worker for this ticket. Complete it if cleanly possible; otherwise surface blockers fast. Do not spawn child agents, coordinate unrelated tickets, commit, push, or store secrets. Report completion by updating this XML ticket.
ticket.work_ethos: Move fast inside the lane. Guardrails are coordination guidance to avoid clobbering other agents, not a hard sandbox. If the task clearly requires touching outside the lane, do it narrowly and explain why in the result.

guardrails.item: Prefer staying inside lane_guidance to avoid colliding with other agents.
If touching outside lane_guidance is necessary, do it narrowly and explain why.
Do not overwrite unrelated user or agent changes.
Do not leave long-lived processes running.
Do not modify external repos unless the ticket explicitly says so.
Do not write durable memories, roadmap entries, logs, commands.xml, or workflow docs unless explicitly instructed. Put proposed durable content under this ticket's attachments folder instead.
Do not create, rename, delete, or assign tickets. Put follow-up recommendations in this ticket; the orchestrator owns ticket creation.
Do not edit proj-ledger/tools.yaml or proj-ledger/commands.xml; record command discoveries in this ticket.

ticket.tool_policy: Before project commands or missing-runtime conclusions, read proj-ledger/tools.yaml, inspect the relevant manifest for the canonical command/task name, then grep proj-ledger/commands.xml by that name.
ticket.prompt:
Replace with worker-specific instructions.
When done, set root ticket status to returned and set worker_result status to completed, partial, blocked, or deficient. Fill summary, changed_files, checks, risks, next, and commands_run. Use attachments only when they add signal. Put files under `proj-ledger/tickets/attachments/` and link them from this ticket; do not inline long attachments in XML.

worker_result.commands_run: List commands you ran in any clear, copyable form. Include cwd/context if non-obvious.
